metadata.title: Data Handling and Use

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for Data and Information Management that governs how institutional data may be accessed, processed, shared, and used.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Data and information protection technology domain.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Policy-driven constraints on data access, processing, sharing, and purpose of use.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Data use policies, permitted actions, sharing contexts, and purpose bindings.

props.name: threat-technique
props.remarks: Inappropriate access, processing, or sharing of data beyond authorized use.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Definition and enforcement of policies governing acceptable data use.

metadata.remarks: Data Handling and Use defines the capability to constrain how institutional data may be accessed, processed, transformed, shared, and used. This pattern establishes behavioral rules derived from data classification and obligation. It does not define cryptographic protection, leakage prevention mechanisms, or retention requirements.

components.title: Access and Use Rules
components.description: Definition of who may access data and under what approved conditions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Enforce approved authorizations for data access and use.

components.title: Processing and Transformation Rules
components.description: Constraints on permitted processing, analytics, and transformation of data.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Control information flow during data processing and transformation.

components.title: Sharing and Disclosure Rules
components.description: Definition of permissible internal and external data sharing contexts.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Restrict and govern external data sharing and disclosure.

components.title: Purpose Limitation
components.description: Restriction of data use to approved purposes consistent with collection intent.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Limit data use to defined and approved purposes.
